familyRoots: Acclaimed Jalisco birrieros bringing their famous slow-braised recipe and red-chili dipped tortillas to the Inland Empire.
scratchCommitment: Choice beef cuts simmered for 8+ hours with charred guajillo, ancho chiles, Mexican cinnamon, and cloves; broth skimmed continuously to create deep, aromatic red consommé.

destinationDish.name: Crispy Cheese Quesatacos con Consomé
destinationDish.callout: Hand-dipped corn tortillas griddled with crispy charred Oaxaca cheese borders, packed with tender shredded birria and served with boiling consommé.

description: Haven City Market's most sought-after quesataco counter. Famous for deep red dipping consommé, cheesy mulitas, and scratch birria ramen bowls.
story: Starting with generational family seasoning blends from Jalisco, Birria Los Socios crafts authentic birria with unmatched crispiness and soul.

photos.label: Trio of Cheesy Quesatacos Dipped in Red Consomé
Jalisco Birria Mulita & Charro Beans

signatures.name: Quesataco Trio con Consomé
signatures.desc: Three crispy cheese-crusted corn tacos filled with tender shredded beef birria, onions, cilantro, and rich hot consommé for dipping.

signatures.name: Birria Mulita Especial
signatures.desc: Two grilled corn tortillas stuffed with melted cheese, juicy birria, avocado salsa, and fresh cilantro.

signatures.name: Birria Ramen Bowl
signatures.desc: Springy ramen noodles steeped in rich Jalisco birria consommé topped with slow-cooked shredded beef, cilantro, onion, and lime.

regionalClassics.name: Traditional Birria Plate
regionalClassics.desc: Hearty serving of braised beef birria bathed in savory broth, served with Mexican rice, refried beans, and warm handmade tortillas.

regionalClassics.name: Loaded Birria Nachos
regionalClassics.desc: Warm tortilla chips layered with melted nacho cheese, shredded Oaxaca cheese, birria de res, jalapeños, and crema.

combosAndTrays.name: Los Socios Family Pack (Feeds 4)
combosAndTrays.desc: 8 Quesatacos, 2 Large Consomés, 1 Large Mexican Rice, 1 Large Refried Beans, and fresh chips & salsa.

sidesAndDrinks.name: 8 oz Hot Consomé Cup
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Pure, slow-simmered beef birria dipping broth with chopped onions, fresh cilantro, and lime wedges.

sidesAndDrinks.name: Horchata Artesanal
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Traditional rice milk blended with Ceylon cinnamon and pure Mexican vanilla, served ice-cold.

ratings.name: David R.
ratings.comment: The consommé here is on another level. Crispy cheese shell with tender meat is perfection.

ratings.name: Gaby S.
ratings.comment: Best birria ramen in SoCal! Clean counter, quick friendly service.

name: The Kroft (Haven City Market)
regionalIdentity: Artisanal Comfort Food & Wagyu Smash Craft
familyRoots: A chef-driven indie comfort counter inside Haven City Market redefining American comfort classics with scratch-made sauces and prime meats.
scratchCommitment: Double-fried Belgian-cut russet fries, house-rendered 24-hour braised beef gravies, fresh squeaky cheese curds, and custom-ground Wagyu smash patties seared to order.

destinationDish.name: Short Rib Poutine & Spicy Jack Wagyu Smash Burger
destinationDish.callout: Crisp Belgian fries piled with 12-hour braised beef short rib, dark demi-glace gravy, Wisconsin cheese curds, and pickled red onions.

description: Haven City Market's premier comfort food maker. Searing lacy-edged Wagyu smash patties and layering piping-hot poutines with slow-simmered scratch gravies.
story: Founded on the philosophy that comfort food should never use frozen shortcuts, The Kroft makes every jus, aioli, and fry cut in-house daily.

photos.label: Short Rib Poutine with Wisconsin Cheese Curds
Spicy Jack Wagyu Smash Burger

signatures.name: Braised Short Rib Poutine
signatures.desc: Double-cooked fries, tender braised short rib, scratch demi-glace gravy, melted cheese curds, and pickled red onions.

signatures.name: French Onion Wagyu Smash Burger
signatures.desc: Two smashed American Wagyu patties, Gruyère cheese, deeply caramelized onions, and garlic-herb aioli on a brioche bun.

signatures.name: Chicken Tikka Poutine
signatures.desc: Crisp fries smothered with spiced chicken tikka masala gravy, fresh cheese curds, cilantro, and crushed chili flakes.

regionalClassics.name: Classic Fried Cheese Curds
regionalClassics.desc: Beer-battered Wisconsin cheddar curds flash-fried golden, served with house garlic herb ranch.

regionalClassics.name: Crispy Buttermilk Chicken Parm Sandwich
regionalClassics.desc: Hand-breaded chicken breast, slow-simmered marinara, melted mozzarella, and fresh basil on toasted brioche.

combosAndTrays.name: Kroft Market Feast (Feeds 3-4)
combosAndTrays.desc: 1 Short Rib Poutine, 2 Wagyu Smash Burgers, 1 Order Fried Curds, and 3 House Lemonades.

sidesAndDrinks.name: Garlic Parmesan Truffle Fries
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Belgian fries tossed in white truffle oil, shaved parmesan, garlic, and fresh parsley.

sidesAndDrinks.name: House-Brewed Blackberry Lemonade
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Muddled fresh blackberries and cold-pressed lemon juice lightly sweetened with cane sugar.

ratings.name: Marcus H.
ratings.comment: Short rib poutine is mind-blowing. The cheese curds actually squeak and the gravy is incredible.

ratings.name: Elena V.
ratings.comment: Best smash burger in Rancho. Haven City Market vibe is lively and spotless.

name: Changan Kitchen (印象长安)
regionalIdentity: Xi'an & Shaanxi Provincial Noodle House
familyRoots: Independently owned Xi'an noodle kitchen off Milliken Ave bringing northwestern Shaanxi dough-stretching traditions to the Inland Empire.
scratchCommitment: High-gluten belt noodles hand-stretched and slapped to order against the butcher block; beef shank bone broth simmered 14 hours with star anise, Sichuan peppercorn, and Cassia bark.

destinationDish.name: Xi'an Cumin Beef Biang-Biang Belt Noodles
destinationDish.callout: Two-inch-wide hand-ripped ribbons seared with toasted cumin seed, charred scallions, and sizzling Shaanxi Qinjiao chili oil poured tableside.

description: Skip generic strip-mall chow mein. Changan Kitchen pulls thick, chewy Shaanxi belt noodles to order and ladles 14-hour spiced marrow broth over tender beef shank.
story: Named after Chang'an—the ancient Silk Road capital known today as Xi'an—the kitchen refuses machine-cut pasta, stretching every bowl by hand when the ticket prints.

photos.label: Xi'an Cumin Beef Biang-Biang Belt Noodles
14-Hour Shaanxi Spicy Beef Shank Noodle Soup
Pan-Seared Pork & Chive Potstickers with Black Vinegar

signatures.name: Xi'an Cumin Beef Biang-Biang Noodles
signatures.desc: Hand-slapped wide belt noodles wok-tossed with seared flank steak, crushed roasted cumin, garlic shoots, and sizzled Shaanxi chili oil.

signatures.name: Shaanxi Braised Beef Shank Noodle Soup
signatures.desc: 14-hour five-spice bone marrow broth, thick-cut braised beef shank, baby bok choy, fresh cilantro, and hand-pulled round noodles.

signatures.name: Sichuan Mala Boiled Fish (Shui Zhu Yu)
signatures.desc: Silky white fish fillets poached in numbing green-peppercorn and dried-chili broth over bean sprouts and napa cabbage.

regionalClassics.name: Sichuan Street Dan Dan Noodles
regionalClassics.desc: Crisp minced pork, preserved Yibin ya-cai mustard greens, roasted sesame paste, and numbing red chili oil.

regionalClassics.name: Shaanxi Sour & Spicy Pork Dumpling Soup (Suantang Shuijiao)
regionalClassics.desc: Plump house-folded pork dumplings swimming in aged black-vinegar, sesame, and chili oil broth.

regionalClassics.name: Old Chang'an Spiced Lamb Offal Soup
regionalClassics.desc: Slow-simmered bone broth with tender lamb, vermicelli glass noodles, cilantro, and toasted flatbread.

combosAndTrays.name: Silk Road Family Noodle Feast (Feeds 4)
combosAndTrays.desc: 1 Biang-Biang Cumin Beef, 1 Braised Beef Shank Noodle Soup, 1 Sichuan Boiled Fish, 12 Handmade Dumplings & Smashed Cucumber Salad.

combosAndTrays.name: Hand-Folded Dumpling Party Platter (40 pcs)
combosAndTrays.desc: Half pork-and-chive, half cabbage-and-pork dumplings with house chili crisp and Zhenjiang black vinegar.

sidesAndDrinks.name: Garlic-Smashed Cucumber Salad (Pai Huang Gua)
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Crushed Persian cucumbers tossed in raw garlic, sesame oil, and aged rice vinegar.

sidesAndDrinks.name: House-Brewed Sweet Osmanthus & Plum Drink (Suanmeitang)
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Traditional smoky-sweet chilled sour plum decoction brewed to cut rich chili oil.

ratings.name: Marcus L.
ratings.comment: You can literally hear them slapping the biang-biang dough on the counter in the kitchen. Cumin beef noodles are unbeatable.

ratings.name: wendy Z.
ratings.comment: Real Xi'an flavors right on Milliken. The spicy beef noodle broth is rich without being greasy.

ratings.name: Devon K.
ratings.comment: Smashed cucumbers + cumin beef belt noodles every single week.

name: Not Your Mama's Kitchen (NYMK)
regionalIdentity: Deep South Scratch Soul Food & Catfish Fry House
familyRoots: Family-owned & operated right on E. Riverside Dr in South Ontario (91761), cooking small-batch Southern plates from generational family recipes.
scratchCommitment: Collard greens slow-simmered for 4 hours with smoked turkey necks; catfish dredged to order in seasoned yellow cornmeal; 5-cheese mac baked in cast-iron pans.

destinationDish.name: Cornmeal-Crusted Delta Catfish & 5-Cheese Baked Mac Plate
destinationDish.callout: Three golden, crunch-fried catfish fillets with cast-iron baked macaroni & cheese, smoked-turkey collards, and a warm honey-butter cornbread muffin.

description: Situated right in the heart of 91761 on E. Riverside Dr, NYMK fries every catfish fillet and buttermilk bird to order and bakes real crusted mac and cheese.
story: Built for neighbors tired of heat-lamp chains—every plate comes with a warm scratch cornbread muffin and sides seasoned the slow way.

photos.label: Cornmeal-Crusted Delta Catfish & Baked Mac Plate
Honey-Hot Fried Chicken & Belgian Waffle Platter
Gulf Shrimp Po' Boy, Candied Yams & Peach Cobbler

signatures.name: Cornmeal-Crusted Catfish Dinner (3 Fillets)
signatures.desc: Three hand-battered catfish fillets fried crisp, served with two scratch Southern sides and a warm cornbread muffin.

signatures.name: Buttermilk-Brined Fried Chicken Plate (3 pc)
signatures.desc: 24-hour seasoned buttermilk brine, golden-fried white or dark meat, two signature sides, and cornbread.

signatures.name: Honey-Hot Party Wings & Belgian Waffle
signatures.desc: Six crisp-fried whole wings glazed in house Honey-Hot or Lemon Pepper over a thick malted waffle.

regionalClassics.name: Smothered Fried Turkey Chops
regionalClassics.desc: Seasoned pan-fried turkey chops over steamed rice & brown pan gravy with two sides.

regionalClassics.name: Louisiana-Style Fried Shrimp Po' Boy
regionalClassics.desc: Crispy battered Gulf shrimp piled on a toasted French roll with remoulade, lettuce, and pickles.

regionalClassics.desc: Your choice of any three slow-cooked sides plus a sweet cornbread muffin.

combosAndTrays.desc: 6 pcs Fried Chicken, 4 pcs Fried Catfish, 12 Honey-Hot Wings, two large sides (Mac & Cheese + Collards) & 4 Cornbread Muffins.

combosAndTrays.name: 24-Piece Glazed Party Wing Tray
combosAndTrays.desc: Mix-and-match Honey Hot, Sweet Thangs, or Lemon Pepper with ranch and seasoned fries.

sidesAndDrinks.name: Smoked-Turkey Collard Greens / Baked Mac 'n Cheese / Candied Yams
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Slow-braised greens with smoked turkey (no pork), five-cheese baked macaroni, or cinnamon-nutmeg yams.

sidesAndDrinks.name: Spiced Brown-Sugar Peach Cobbler & Southern Sweet Tea
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Deep-dish buttery crust peach cobbler paired with a 24oz cane-sugar Sweet Tea or half-and-half Arnold Palmer.

ratings.name: Tasha M.
ratings.comment: 98 health score and you can taste how clean the fry oil is. Catfish and mac & cheese are 10/10.

ratings.name: Darnell B.
ratings.comment: Right off Riverside Dr in 91761! The Honey-Hot wings and collard greens taste like Sunday dinner.

name: Pho K Plus Vietnamese Cuisine
regionalIdentity: Saigon-Style Marrow Broth Pho & Cơm Tấm Grill
familyRoots: Family-operated Vietnamese kitchen on N. Archibald Ave serving Ontario warehouse crews and local families 7 days a week.
scratchCommitment: Beef leg bones par-boiled and skimmed, then slow-simmered for 12 hours with charred ginger, blackened yellow onion, and whole star anise pods.

destinationDish.name: Phở Đặc Biệt (Saigon House Special Filet Mignon & Bone Marrow Broth)
destinationDish.callout: Crystal-clear 12-hour charred-ginger beef broth poured boiling hot over paper-thin raw filet mignon, slow-cooked brisket, tendon, and beef meatballs.

description: A 97-score Grade-A Saigon noodle house where the marrow pots simmer overnight and the garlic-butter wings come out crackly and caramelized.
story: Tucked into the Archibald strip plaza, Pho K Plus wins regulars with crystal-clean broth that never relies on heavy MSG shortcuts.

photos.label: Phở Đặc Biệt with Rare Filet Mignon & 12-Hour Broth
Caramelized Fish-Sauce & Garlic-Butter Wings
Saigon Broken Rice (Cơm Tấm) with Lemongrass Pork Chop

signatures.name: Phở Đặc Biệt (House Combination Filet Mignon Pho)
signatures.desc: Rare Angus filet mignon, well-done brisket, flank, soft tendon, tripe, and beef meatballs in 12-hour charred-onion marrow broth.

signatures.name: Cánh Gà Chiên Bơ Tỏi (Caramelized Garlic-Butter Wings)
signatures.desc: Double-fried crispy chicken wings wok-tossed in browned butter, crispy fried garlic bits, and sweet fish-sauce glaze.

signatures.name: Cơm Tấm Sườn Nướng (Saigon Broken Rice & Lemongrass Pork Chop)

regionalClassics.name: Bánh Mì Thịt Nướng (Saigon Charbroiled Pork Baguette)
regionalClassics.desc: Crackly hollow French baguette spread with house mayo, pickled carrots & daikon, cucumber, cilantro, jalapeño, and grilled pork.

combosAndTrays.name: Pho Lovers Dinner for Two
combosAndTrays.desc: 2 Large Phở (any cut), 1 order Caramelized Garlic-Butter Wings (6 pc) & 2 Fresh Shrimp Spring Rolls with peanut hoisin sauce.

combosAndTrays.name: Crispy Chả Giò & Gỏi Cuốn Party Tray (24 Rolls)
combosAndTrays.desc: 12 crispy pork-and-taro egg rolls + 12 fresh shrimp-and-pork rice-paper spring rolls with house peanut sauce.

sidesAndDrinks.name: Gỏi Cuốn Tôm Thịt (Fresh Shrimp & Herb Spring Rolls, 2 pc)
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Steamed tiger shrimp, poached pork, vermicelli, and mint wrapped to order with roasted-peanut hoisin dip.

sidesAndDrinks.name: Cà Phê Sữa Đá (Slow-Drip Phin Vietnamese Iced Coffee)
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Dark-roast robusta chicory coffee dripped over sweetened condensed milk and pebble ice.

ratings.name: Kevin T.
ratings.comment: Broth is super clean and aromatic, and the garlic butter wings are mandatory.

ratings.name: Linh N.
ratings.comment: Best Cơm Tấm pork chop in Ontario. Generous meat portions and a spotless dining room.

name: Taqueria 2 Potrillos
regionalIdentity: Jalisco-Style Birria de Res & Michoacán Cazo Carnitas
familyRoots: Family-run Holt Boulevard taqueria known across the West Inland Empire for open-kettle carnitas, trompo al pastor, and Jalisco birria.
scratchCommitment: Birria braised 6 hours in toasted guajillo, ancho, and árbol chiles; thick gordita and mulita masa hand-pressed on the comal to order.

destinationDish.name: Quesabirria Dorada Trio with Guajillo-Marrow Consomé
destinationDish.callout: Three tortillas dipped in red chili birria fat, griddled crisp with melted Oaxaca cheese and tender shredded beef, served with a steaming cup of rich consomé.

description: No Tex-Mex shortcuts—Taqueria 2 Potrillos runs a real vertical al pastor trompo, simmers copper-kettle carnitas, and presses thick masa gorditas on Holt Blvd.
story: Locals line up from 9am for chorizo breakfast burritos until 11pm on weekends for late-night quesabirria and charro beans.

Hand-Pressed Michoacán Carnitas Masa Gordita
Trompo Al Pastor Tacos, Charro Beans & Aguas Frescas

signatures.name: Michoacán Carnitas Handmade Gordita
signatures.desc: Thick griddled corn masa pocket stuffed with copper-cazo pork shoulder, refried pinto beans, cotija, crema, and pickled red onions.

signatures.name: Trompo Al Pastor Mulita
signatures.desc: Two fresh corn tortillas sandwiching spit-carved achiote pork, charred pineapple, and melted Monterrey Jack cheese.

regionalClassics.name: Lengua & Cabeza Vapor Tacos

regionalClassics.desc: House-spiced pork chorizo, scrambled eggs, crispy country potatoes, pinto beans, and jack cheese.

sidesAndDrinks.name: Frijoles Charros (Cowboy Bacon & Chorizo Pinto Beans)
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Whole pinto beans simmered with smoky bacon, chorizo, tomato, jalapeño, and cilantro.

sidesAndDrinks.name: Scratch Aguas Frescas (32oz Horchata, Jamaica, Tamarindo, Piña)
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Cinnamon-soaked rice horchata, steeped hibiscus flower, or fresh pulp tamarind made every morning.

ratings.name: Carlos R.
ratings.comment: The quesabirria consomé has real depth and the gorditas are pressed thick by hand.

ratings.name: Elena V.
ratings.comment: Their frijoles charros and carnitas beat spots twice the price.

name: Los Cebollines Grill
regionalIdentity: San Salvador-Style Comal Pupuseria & Latin Grill
familyRoots: Family-owned Salvadoran kitchen on E. 4th St in Ontario, hand-patting pupusas and simmering traditional soups from morning to night.
scratchCommitment: Every pupusa is hand-slapped from warm corn masa when ordered—never par-cooked—and paired with house-fermented oregano cabbage curtido.

destinationDish.name: Pupusas Revueltas & Loroco con Quesillo off the Comal
destinationDish.callout: Griddled masa rounds stuffed with ground chicharrón, red beans, and stretchy Salvadoran quesillo, or fragrant Central American loroco flower buds.

description: True San Salvador comfort cooking in Ontario: sizzling comal pupusas, crispy cassava root with pork chunks, and fruit-packed Salvadoran frescos.
story: While fast-food chains pre-press tortillas, the pupuseras at Los Cebollines pat every single masa round by hand to order so the cheese caramelizes on the edges.

photos.label: Comal-Seared Pupusas Revueltas with Curtido & Salsa Roja
Yuca Frita con Chicharrón, Beef Pastelitos & Plátanos
Bistec Encebollado & Fresh Salvadoran Ensalada de Fruta

signatures.name: Pupusa Revuelta (Chicharrón, Red Beans & Quesillo)
signatures.desc: Hand-patted corn masa stuffed with seasoned ground pork, silky Salvadoran red beans, and melted quesillo, griddled until blistered.

signatures.name: Pupusa de Loroco con Queso (Vegetarian)
signatures.desc: Filled with earthy, aromatic Salvadoran loroco vine blossoms and stretchy white cheese, served with tangy curtido and warm tomato salsa.

signatures.desc: Golden-fried cassava root chunks, crispy pork belly chicharrón, and crunchy half-moon corn turnovers stuffed with seasoned beef and potato.

regionalClassics.desc: Rich herb-scented hen broth with chayote, yuca, corn, carrots, and a flame-grilled quarter chicken on the side.

combosAndTrays.desc: Any 12 handmade pupusas (Revuelta, Loroco, Chicharrón, Frijol con Queso, or Jalapeño) with 2 large bags of curtido and salsa roja.

combosAndTrays.desc: 15 assorted pupusas plus a large tray of sweet fried plantains with Salvadoran crema and refried red beans.

sidesAndDrinks.name: Plátanos Fritos con Crema y Frijoles
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Ripe black-skin plantains pan-fried in butter until caramelized, plated with thick Salvadoran sweet cream and pureed red beans.

sidesAndDrinks.name: Fresco de Ensalada de Fruta / Horchata de Morro
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Salvadoran fruit drink loaded with finely diced apple, pineapple, mamey, and marañón, or spiced morro-seed horchata.

ratings.name: Gabriela M.
ratings.comment: Real loroco pupusas and morro horchata! The burnt cheese edges on the pupusas are perfection.

ratings.name: Oscar P.
ratings.comment: 12-pack pupusa bundle feeds our whole crew for cheap. Yuca con chicharrón is super crispy.

name: Greenhills Market & Fast Food
regionalIdentity: Pampanga-Style Turo-Turo Steam Table & Weekend Silog
familyRoots: Long-standing neighborhood Filipino market and hot turo-turo counter on S. Vineyard Ave in 91761 with a perfect 100/100 County health score.
scratchCommitment: Oxtail and beef kare-kare simmered until fork-tender in toasted ground peanut sauce; fresh bangus milkfish and pork belly fried to order at the butcher counter.

destinationDish.name: Pampanga Chicken & Pork Belly Adobo + Oxtail Kare-Kare Combo
destinationDish.callout: Two-item turo-turo plate over garlic sinangag rice: cane-vinegar braised pork & chicken adobo alongside rich peanut kare-kare with sautéed bagoong.

description: Holding a spotless 100/100 Grade-A health inspection right in 91761, Greenhills serves authentic homestyle Filipino stews, weekend silog breakfasts, and a 'you buy, we fry' seafood counter.
story: Part Filipino pantry, part bustling kitchen—locals line up Saturday mornings at 9am sharp for garlic rice, sweet longanisa, and crispy whole fried fish.

photos.label: Pampanga Chicken & Pork Adobo with Sinangag & Lumpia

Weekend Tapsilog & Longsilog Garlic-Rice Breakfast

signatures.name: 2-Item Turo-Turo Combo Plate (Adobo + Kare-Kare)
signatures.desc: Served over steamed or garlic rice with cane-vinegar Chicken & Pork Adobo and rich peanut Oxtail/Beef Kare-Kare with shrimp paste.

signatures.name: Bicol Express (Coconut Milk & Chili Braised Pork Belly)
signatures.desc: Tender cubed pork belly simmered in rich coconut cream, Thai bird chiles, and savory shrimp paste.

regionalClassics.desc: Kabocha squash, okra, eggplant, string beans, and ampalaya sautéed with crispy pork and bagoong.

combosAndTrays.desc: Hand-rolled crispy pork, carrot, and water-chestnut spring rolls fried golden with sweet chili sauce.

combosAndTrays.desc: Stir-fried thin rice noodles with chicken, shrimp, and cabbage plus 25 crispy lumpia and calamansi.

sidesAndDrinks.name: Crispy Lumpia Shanghai (10 pcs) or Turon (Jackfruit Banana Roll)
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Savory pork spring rolls or brown-sugar caramelized saba banana & jackfruit wrapper rolls.

sidesAndDrinks.name: Fresh Calamansi Juice & Halo-Halo Cup
sidesAndDrinks.desc: Sweet-tart Philippine limeade or shaved milk ice layered with ube halaya, leche flan, sweet beans, and macapuno.

ratings.name: Jun D.
ratings.comment: 100 health score! Their kare-kare and weekend bangsilog breakfast taste just like home.

ratings.name: Marissa C.
ratings.comment: Best turo-turo value in 91761. We order their lumpia and pancit trays for every birthday.

name: Thai Family Sisters Restaurant
regionalIdentity: Chiang Mai Khao Soi & Wok-Fired Siamese Homestyle
familyRoots: Run by two sisters in Upland Village on S. Mountain Ave, cooking family recipes from Northern and Central Thailand.
scratchCommitment: Khao Soi curry paste pounded with roasted coriander seed, cardamom, and turmeric, then simmered in first-press coconut cream.
